investment_strategy: Constructive-but-selective AI-led equity allocation. With the VIX at ~16.7, the 10-year yield near 3.8%, and major indices showing positive 30-day momentum, we overweight high-quality AI platforms and compute beneficiaries while capping exposure to higher-volatility semis. We prioritize companies with strong fundamentals, clear AI monetization paths, and positive analyst consensus, while sizing down positions facing elevated regulatory or geopolitics risk. Risk controls: overweight lower-volatility compounders (MSFT), moderate weight to platform with strong growth but antitrust overhang (GOOGL), and smaller, capped position in the AI compute leader (NVDA). Rebalance quarterly or on 15% position drift; trim if VIX > 25 or if regulatory/geopolitical headlines materially change risk-reward.
